context: Mother and daughter shop for housewares — glassware, books, lifestyle items
purpose: Teach: トイレ/ガラス/メートル/文庫/余り/いらっしゃる/ハウス/ライフ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: このお店、ライフスタイル雑貨が揃ってて便利よね。トイレ用のマットもここで見ようか。
lines.en: This shop has everything for lifestyle goods, so handy. Let's look for a toilet mat here too.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone with a practical shopping checklist cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん。ねえお母さん、あのガラスのコップ見て、めっちゃ可愛くない?
lines.en: Yeah. Hey Mom, look at that glass cup, isn't it super cute?
lines.style: Bright teenage excitement with rising enthusiastic pitch

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当だ。でもうちの棚、もう余りスペースがないのよ。
lines.en: You're right. But our shelves don't have much extra space left, you know.
lines.style: Gently restraining voice with a soft apologetic sigh

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええ〜。じゃあ文庫本コーナーだけ寄ってもいい?新しいの読みたいの。
lines.en: Aww. Then can we just stop by the paperback corner? I want to read something new.
lines.style: Whiny pleading shift into hopeful negotiation

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわよ。あ、二階の本売り場には作家さんがサイン会でいらっしゃるみたい。
lines.en: Sure. Oh, it seems an author is here on the second floor for a signing event.
lines.style: Pleasantly surprised announcement with mild curiosity rising

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 嘘、行きたい!エスカレーター、何メートルくらい先?
lines.en: No way, I want to go! How many meters away is the escalator?
lines.style: Sudden energized urgency, almost bouncing on her feet

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: すぐそこよ。帰りにモデルハウスのカタログも貰っていきたいから、急ぎましょう。
lines.en: Just over there. I want to grab the model house catalog on the way back too, so let's hurry.
lines.style: Brisk maternal scheduling voice, gently herding her daughter along
